_comment: Project definitions. Edit this file, then run: python tools/build.py. Photos come from Photos/<folder> in filename order -- that order is the sequence the project page renders, so name them 01, 02, 03. Ratings never reorder a project.
_alt_comment: 'alt' maps a filename to a description of the photograph, used as the accessible name of its button. Without it a screen reader gets the project title repeated once per frame, which is useless. Describe what is in the frame, not how good it is.

projects.title: Cloka CLC
projects.subtitle: Activewear campaign · July 2026
projects._summary_note: PLACEHOLDER — replace with your own copy. Written from what is visible in the frames only; no client, brief or location has been assumed.
projects.summary: A training-floor session for activewear label Cloka: lifting under the gym's orange and teal light, apparel worn in use rather than staged, and close detail on the branding itself.
projects._cover_note: Set to null to let the build pick the highest-rated frame. It chose 13.jpg (the logo macro) — technically the sharpest, but a detail shot makes a weak campaign card, so 11 is named explicitly: product worn in use, branding fully legible, the shoot's teal/orange light at its strongest.

projects.title: Almost Three
projects.subtitle: Maternity shoot · December 2025
projects.summary: A winter maternity session on a coastal causeway, timed so the sun sat low behind the water for the last of it. Red tulle against bare trees and a hard blue sky, close enough to catch the small moments between the two of them — and the dog got a frame of its own.

alt.02.jpg: A woman in a red gown resting both hands on her bump, bare winter branches overhead
alt.03.jpg: The same woman laughing, red gown against bare trees and open blue sky
alt.04.jpg: Extreme close-up of her eye and cheekbone, a pearl earring just in frame
alt.05.jpg: The couple turned towards each other under bare branches, sky bright behind
alt.06.jpg: The couple cheek to cheek, both smiling, framed tight
alt.07.jpg: A small dog sitting on a wooden deck against a backdrop of the same red tulle
alt.08.jpg: Low angle looking up: the red gown spread wide against a deep blue winter sky
alt.09.jpg: A silhouette on the causeway as the sun sets behind her, the gown lifting in the wind
alt.10.jpg: The couple with their foreheads touching, backlit by the last of the sun

projects.title: Abhinaya
projects.subtitle: Classical dance recital · 2026
projects.summary: A solo recital shot tight against a black stage, where the only light is the one the performer is standing in. The set moves between full posture and the details the form actually lives in: the mudras of the hands, the alta on the fingers, and the expression carrying the story.

alt.01.jpg: A dancer in a purple and gold silk costume standing in position on a dark stage, one hand raised in a mudra
alt.02.jpg: The dancer mid movement, one arm swept above the head, costume pleats fanning out
alt.03.jpg: Tight portrait: temple jewellery across the forehead, jasmine in the hair, gaze held steady
alt.04.jpg: The dancer standing square to the camera, hands at the waist, gold blouse catching the light
alt.05.jpg: A standing portrait with one hand lifted, fingers shaped into a mudra
alt.06.jpg: Close on the face and hands together, fingertips stained red with alta
alt.07.jpg: Close frame, smiling, both hands held in a mudra at chest height
alt.08.jpg: Close frame with the hands cupped together in front of the chest
alt.09.jpg: Full length on the stage floor, arms extended, weight low in the stance
alt.10.jpg: Tight frame, one hand raised beside the face, expression carrying the line

projects.title: Cobalt
projects.subtitle: Portrait editorial · 2026
projects._overlap_note: 04, 02, 03 and 05 are the same frames published in the gallery as Tailored in Mono, Cobalt Poise, Cobalt Gaze and Cobalt Ascent. Kept in both places deliberately.
projects.summary: A tailored cobalt suit worked against the two hardest surfaces the block had to offer — old brick with the street falling away behind it, and raw board-marked concrete. Shot mostly tight, with one frame taken down to black and white where the colour stopped adding anything.

alt.03.jpg: Closer in, hands brought together, the concrete wall filling the frame
alt.04.jpg: Black and white: the suit against brick with city buildings rising behind
alt.05.jpg: Full length beside a stair rail, concrete behind, hands at the collar
alt.06.jpg: A wide crop of head and shoulders turned against the concrete
